空间清理会自动删除文件吗？可以撤销吗？: Does cleanup delete files automatically? Can I undo it?
不会。扫描只列出候选，默认不选择任何文件，确认后才移到废纸篓；执行前会复查文件身: No. Scanning only lists candidates and selects nothing by default. Confirmed files are moved to Trash after identity and usage checks. Running apps, protected data and uncertain items are kept. General cleanup and other apps’ cache cleanup can be undone with ⌘Z in the current session. WeChat attachments can be recovered from Trash. Moving files to Trash does not immediately free disk space; usage figures are estimates.
为什么有些软件没有出现在软件清理列表？: Why are some apps missing from Software cleanup?
列表根据本机可读取的清理目录生成，不是所有已安装软件的清单。没有识别到缓存或日志: The list comes from readable cleanup folders on this Mac, rather than every installed app. Apps without identified cache or log folders, plus helper, updater and extension components, are hidden. WeChat uses its own local attachment scanner. Other apps are limited to identified caches and logs, preserving accounts, settings, databases and offline content. Use Refresh app list after new folders appear.
微信清理能看到所有聊天文件吗？会删除聊天记录吗？: Can WeChat cleanup find every chat file? Does it delete chat history?
只扫描已下载到这台 Mac 的附件及可识别缓存，不读取或解密聊天数据库。手机独有: Only locally downloaded attachments and supported cache locations are scanned. Chat databases are not read or decrypted. Files that exist only on your phone or have not been downloaded to this Mac will not appear. You can add custom attachment folders; date filters use file modification times. Preview attachments before confirming a move to Trash.
连接安卓设备，需要先做什么？: How do I connect an Android device?
先安装 Android Platform Tools（adb），用 USB 连接: Install Android Platform Tools (adb), connect over USB, enable USB debugging and authorize this Mac on the device. WinFile will list the device in the sidebar. Android permissions may restrict folders such as Android/data.
支持哪些解压格式？会覆盖已有文件吗？: Which archives can I extract? Will existing files be overwritten?
支持 ZIP、RAR（含 RAR5）、7Z、TAR，以及 GZip、BZip2、: Extract ZIP, RAR (including RAR5), 7Z, TAR, GZip, BZip2 and XZ files, including compressed TAR archives, passwords and split volumes. Extraction uses a staging folder, and naming conflicts are saved separately without overwriting existing files. Archive creation currently supports ZIP.
从 v1.2.0 起，WinFile 支持启动时检查更新。你可以安装、跳过某个版: From v1.2.0, WinFile checks for updates on launch. Install, skip a version or choose a reminder, or check manually in the app. Both update archives and the feed are verified with Ed25519 signatures. Older versions need one manual upgrade from GitHub first.
